summary: Adds a BankAccount table (beneficiary/bank details, account + routing numbers, type, SWIFT, primary flag) owned by a company with a migration, plus an unused placeholder BankAccountModal ('Please clone this file and implement the modal.'). Nothing in the app reads or writes bank accounts yet.

statements.text: ! Bank accounts now store the account number as plain text. Anyone who gets a copy of your database can read it. Encrypt it, or let your payment provider keep it.
statements.why: accountNumber and routingNumber are plain String columns in schema.prisma/migration.

statements.text: + Your database now stores bank accounts: beneficiary name, ..., date updated. Each one belongs to a company.
• Companies are now linked to bank accounts.
1. Apply prisma/migrations/20240718223224_add_bank_account to your live database before the new code goes live (`npx prisma migrate deploy`)... Don't use the `db:migrate` script there.
statements.why: Additive migration, not auto-applied; db:migrate is prisma migrate dev.

misses.what: Unique index on (companyId, primary) means a company can have at most one non-primary bank account; adding a third account will fail once the feature is built.
A placeholder 'Please clone this file and implement the modal.' BankAccountModal was registered (not opened anywhere yet); there is no user-facing bank account feature in this commit.
